subject: Music Production
title: Why Music Gives You Chills
description: Learn Why Music Gives You Chills in one minute.

hook.text: Certain moments in songs can send shivers down your spine and raise goosebumps on your skin.

buildup.text: Scientists found that these chills occur when music violates your brain's harmonic expectations.

discovery.text: The surprise triggers a dopamine rush in the brain's reward system, identical to food or love.

twist.text: Not everyone experiences musical chills equally; about half the population reports them frequently.

climax.text: Great producers craft moments of tension and surprise to trigger these powerful emotional responses.

punchline.text: Music hacks the brain's reward system with surprise.

quiz.question: What triggers musical chills in the brain?
options: Violated harmonic expectations causing a dopamine rush
